blocks.text: Experience the perfect blend of performance and value with the Motorola moto G 2025 for Total Wireless. Whether you're a photography enthusiast, a mobile gamer, or someone who needs a reliable smartphone for daily tasks, the moto G 2025 is designed to impress. Stunning Visuals on a Grand Scale - Immerse yourself in the expansive 6.7-inch display that brings your favorite content to life. The impressive 120Hz refresh rate provides an incredibly smooth and fluid visual experience, making everything from scrolling through your social feeds to intense gaming sessions a delight. Capture Memories in Brilliant Detail with the 50MP Quad Pixel camera system that allows you to take incredibly detailed and vibrant photos, day or night. From picturesque landscapes to close-up shots, your images will be sharp and full of color. The 16MP front-facing camera is perfect for capturing high-quality selfies and for crystal-clear video calls with friends and family. Power That Lasts - Leave battery anxiety behind with the massive 5000mAh battery. Enjoy hours of uninterrupted usage, whether you're watching videos, listening to music, or browsing the web. When you finally need to power up, TurboPower™ charging gets you back in action in no time. Seamless Performance and All the Space You Need Powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor and 5G connectivity, the moto G 2025 delivers a smooth and responsive experience. With a generous 128GB of internal storage, you'll have ample room for your apps, photos, and files. And if that's not enough, you can easily expand the storage up to 1TB with a microSD card. This Motorola moto G 2025 is locked to the Total Wireless network, ensuring you get the best of Total Wireless's reliable coverage and fast 5G speeds.

items.label: Carrier
items.value: This phone is locked to Total Wireless and can only be used on the Total Wireless network. A Total Wirelss plan is required for activation. Activation is simple and can be done online upon receipt of your device following 3 EASY steps.

items.label: IMMERSIVE 6.7” 120HZ DISPLAY
items.value: Experience entertainment like never before on the expansive 6.7-inch screen with a smooth 120Hz refresh rate. Enjoy fluid scrolling, seamless gaming, and cinematic viewing, all with vibrant colors and crisp details.

items.label: 50MP QUAD PIXEL CAMERA SYSTEM
items.value: Capture stunningly sharp and bright photos in any light with the advanced 50MP main camera. The 16MP front camera ensures your selfies are always social media-ready.

items.label: LONG-LASTING 5000MAH BATTERY
items.value: Power through your day and more with the robust 5000mAh battery. Stream, browse, and connect without the worry of constantly needing to recharge.

items.label: RELIABLE 5G PERFORMANCE & AMPLE STORAGE
items.value: Experience the speed of 5G connectivity powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor. With 128GB of internal storage, expandable up to 1TB with a microSD card (sold separately), you'll have plenty of space for all your photos, apps, and videos.
